column5: fact   (ALL PRODUCT, CENTER AND PATIENT FACTS BELOW ARE FICTIONAL DEMO DATA)
Product: Immunonco (fictional demo brand), a BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Launched about 90 days ago. Delivered by subcutaneous step-up dosing.

Approved indication: adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least four prior lines of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent and an anti-CD38 antibody. Use outside this population is off-label.

A REMS program is required: the prescriber AND the treatment center must be enrolled and certified before the first dose. Enrollment is online and typically takes 3-5 business days. Reps may share the enrollment checklist but may not complete enrollment on the HCP's behalf.

Boxed warning: cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and neurologic toxicity including ICANS. First step-up doses require monitoring (hospitalization per label for the first doses at a certified center). Tocilizumab must be available on site.

Funnel stages in order: 1 Aware (has received the label and safety message); 2 REMS-enrolled (prescriber certified); 3 First patient identified (eligible patient named, center confirmed); 4 First patient treated; 5 Repeat prescriber (two or more patients treated).

Off-label or unsolicited clinical questions go to Medical Information (1-800-000-0100, fictional). Possible adverse events must be reported per SOP within 24 hours. Prior-authorization and benefit questions go to the Field Reimbursement Manager.
